response.rationale: A places a TCR-specific capture oligo upstream of the V(D)J junction, bringing CDR3 into the available 225-base read while retaining bead-associated cell labeling. This is consistent with BD’s dedicated high-throughput VDJ/CDR3 library workflow ([BD Rhapsody VDJ CDR3 protocols](https://www.bdbiosciences.com/en-eu/resources/protocols/360039007471-vdj-cdr3-protocols)).
